items.title: vllm-project/vllm released v0.34.0
items.title_zh: vLLM v0.34.0 默认启用内存感知 KV 缓存，并移除 Model Runner V1
items.title_en: vLLM v0.34.0 turns on memory-aware KV cache by default, removes Model Runner V1
items.summary: vLLM v0.34.0 is a large release enabling memory-aware KV cache sizing by default, dropping Model Runner V1, adding 10 models, and delivering meaningful performance gains on Blackwell and MI355X alongside several breaking upgrade changes.

items.title: Optimizely compromised, served malware on Zoom, GitLab
items.title_zh: Optimizely 基础设施遭入侵，向 Zoom 和 GitLab 等站点投放恶意脚本
items.title_en: Optimizely infrastructure compromised, serving malware on Zoom and GitLab
items.summary: Optimizely's infrastructure was compromised and its CDN began serving malicious JavaScript on customer sites including Zoom and GitLab, reigniting debate over the risks of third-party tag managers and script supply chains.

items.title: 美商务部将定稿规则，封堵中国 AI 公司远程用芯，管制扩展至新加坡等东南亚国家  美国商务部正敲定一项规则，阻止中国 AI 公司通过境外数据中心远程使用先进 A
items.title_zh: 美商务部拟定稿新规，封堵中国 AI 公司远程使用先进芯片的漏洞
items.title_en: US Commerce Dept to finalize rule closing remote AI chip access loophole for Chinese firms
items.summary: The U.S. Commerce Department is reportedly finalizing a rule to block Chinese AI companies from remotely accessing advanced AI chips through overseas data centers and to extend controls to several Southeast Asian countries.

items.title: 山东大学团队提出首个哥德巴赫猜想条件性证明
items.title_zh: 山东大学团队提出首个哥德巴赫猜想条件性证明
items.title_en: Shandong University Team Claims First Conditional Proof of Goldbach's Conjecture
items.summary: A Shandong University team claims the first conditional proof that all sufficiently large even numbers are the sum of two primes lying between one-third and two-thirds of the number, assuming a generalized Riemann hypothesis and one of two additional spectral hypotheses.
